description: Matched AMD gsplat (atomic backward) vs Berkelium (same gsplat forward + deterministic HIP backward) on one MI300X. Same scenes, cameras, resolution, parameterization, precision (fp32), profile gsplat_v1, iteration budget. FP64 CPU reference is the oracle for correctness on the small cases only.

estimated_cost.note: estimate only; the FP64 CPU oracle dominates for the 100k case. Billing unit/rate must be checked on the provider before approval.
